map.根据设备类型和运行工况，计算润滑、检查、大修的推荐维护周期: From equipment type and operating condition, compute the recommended maintenance interval for lubrication, inspection and overhaul.
map.实际周期(h) = 基准周期 ÷ 工况系数；周期(天) = 实际周期(h) ÷: Actual interval (h) = base interval / condition factor; interval (days) = actual interval (h) / daily run hours (h)
map.基于预防性维护经验模型：工况系数(0.5~2.0，越大环境越恶劣)缩短维护周期；: Based on a preventive-maintenance empirical model: the condition factor (0.5 to 2.0, larger means harsher environment) shortens the maintenance interval; actual interval = base interval / condition factor, then converted to days by daily run hours, for equipment maintenance scheduling (key equipment suggest adjusting with condition-based inspection).
map.💡 公式：实际周期(h) = 基准周期 ÷ 工况系数；周期(天) = 实际周期(: Tip: formula: actual interval (h) = base interval / condition factor; interval (days) = actual interval (h) / daily run hours (h). Larger condition factor (harsher environment) gives shorter maintenance interval.
map.工况系数参考：清洁环境 0.8、常规 1.0、粉尘/潮湿 1.2~1.5、高温/: Condition-factor reference: clean 0.8, normal 1.0, dusty / humid 1.2 to 1.5, high-temperature / corrosive 1.5 to 2.0
map.基准周期基于行业经验值，实际请以设备厂家说明书为准: Base interval is based on industry experience; actual should follow the equipment manufacturer manual
map.精密设备对润滑要求更高但大修周期较长: Precision equipment needs higher lubrication but has a longer overhaul interval
map.📚 深度解析：设备维护周期（润滑/检查/大修计划）: In-depth: Equipment Maintenance Interval (lubrication / inspection / overhaul plan)
map.预防性维护：为工厂设备制定润滑、检查与大修周期: Preventive maintenance: set lubrication, inspection and overhaul intervals for factory equipment
map.工况调整：按工况系数缩短或延长维护间隔: Condition adjustment: shorten or extend maintenance spacing by the condition factor
map.润滑油配套：按设备类型给出推荐油品牌号: Lubricant matching: recommend an oil grade by equipment type
map.算法：按设备类型取基准周期（运行小时）：轻型 润滑 500/检查 2000/大修: Algorithm: by equipment type take base interval (operating hours): light lubrication 500 / inspection 2000 / overhaul 8000; medium 400 / 1500 / 6000; heavy 300 / 1000 / 5000; precision 600 / 2500 / 10000. Actual interval = base / condition factor; then convert to days / months / years by daily run hours (at or above 365 days show years, at or above 30 days show months, otherwise show days). Condition factor suggest 0.5 to 2.0, harsher gives larger value and shorter interval.
map.例：轻型设备、日均 8h、工况系数 1.0 → 润滑 500h（62.5 天 ≈: Example: light equipment, 8 h/day, condition factor 1.0 gives lubrication 500 h (62.5 days about 2 months), inspection 2000 h (250 days about 8 months), overhaul 8000 h (1000 days about 2.7 years), recommended ISO VG 32/46 total-loss system oil, monthly run 240 h, yearly run 2920 h. Heavy equipment, 16 h/day, factor 1.5 gives lubrication 200 h (12.5 days about 13 days), inspection 667 h (41.7 days about 1 month), overhaul 3333 h (208.3 days about 7 months), recommended ISO VG 150/220 heavy-load gear oil. Precision equipment, 8 h/day, factor 0.8 gives lubrication 750 h (3 months), inspection 3125 h (1.1 years), overhaul 12500 h (4.3 years).
map.工况系数怎么取？: How to choose the condition factor?
Clean light load, good environment take 0.8 to 1.0; dusty, humid, high-temperature or frequent start-stop take 1.2 to 1.5; shock load, continuous full-load take 1.5 to 2.0. Larger factor gives shorter maintenance interval.
map.是通用预防性维护的经验值，可按设备厂家说明书与实际点检结果调整。关键设备建议结合: It is a general preventive-maintenance experience value, adjustable by the equipment manufacturer manual and actual inspection results. Key equipment suggest switching to condition-based maintenance with vibration analysis, oil analysis and infrared thermometry, more economical and reliable than fixed intervals.
map.设备维护周期计算器，根据设备类型（轻型/中型/重型/精密）和日均运行时间、工况系: The equipment maintenance interval calculator, from equipment type (light / medium / heavy / precision) and daily run hours and condition factor, automatically computes the recommended intervals for lubrication, inspection and overhaul, and gives a lubricant-grade suggestion.
